# Design DNA in Gemini CLI

<!-- generated by python install.py docs from hosts/registry/gemini-cli.json -->

## Install

### Gemini CLI: skill folder

Method: skill folder. Capability: **Local agent with a shell**. Runs the engine on your machine. Everything works once the Python packages and a Chromium browser are installed; python install.py doctor checks both.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/OzyAcc/design-dna && cd design-dna
python install.py install --target gemini-cli            # user scope: ~/.gemini/skills/reverse-design
python install.py install --target gemini-cli --scope project --project <your project>   # .gemini/skills/reverse-design
```

Add `--dry-run` to see the changes first. The installer also runs `pip install -r requirements.txt` (skip with `--no-deps`). Without the installer, unzip [design-dna-skill.zip](https://github.com/OzyAcc/design-dna/releases/latest/download/design-dna-skill.zip) into `~/.gemini/skills/`.

### Gemini CLI extension

Method: plugin / extension. Capability: **Local agent with a shell**. Runs the engine on your machine. Everything works once the Python packages and a Chromium browser are installed; python install.py doctor checks both.

1. From GitHub (recommended): gemini extensions install https://github.com/OzyAcc/design-dna --consent; add --auto-update to follow new versions. The installer does the same: python install.py install --target gemini-cli --method extension --from github
2. Gemini CLI treats a GitHub URL as a git source and installs it without its trust-this-folder question, which it asks only for local folders.
3. From this checkout: python install.py install --target gemini-cli --method extension builds ~/design-dna/hosts/gemini-extension/design-dna and runs gemini extensions install <that folder> --consent. Gemini then asks whether to trust the folder: answer it in a terminal; unattended runs need --yes (trusts it for that one command).
4. Restart Gemini CLI; /skills list shows reverse-design.

Package: [design-dna-gemini-extension.zip](https://github.com/OzyAcc/design-dna/releases/latest/download/design-dna-gemini-extension.zip) (or `python install.py package --target gemini-extension`).

Note: On activation Gemini CLI asks for consent and adds the skill folder to the allowed paths.

## Where the host looks

| Scope | Folders this host reads (from its documentation) |
|---|---|
| user | `~/.gemini/skills`, `~/.agents/skills` |
| project | `.gemini/skills`, `.agents/skills` |

If two of these folders hold `reverse-design`, the host picks one by its own precedence rules. `python install.py doctor --target gemini-cli` lists every copy it can see.

## Prerequisites

- Gemini CLI, signed in
- Python 3.10+ and Chromium for the engine

## Check, update, remove

```bash
python install.py doctor --target gemini-cli      # Python, packages, Chromium, store, visible copies
python install.py update --target gemini-cli      # refresh from this checkout (git pull first)
python install.py uninstall --target gemini-cli   # only unmodified copies it installed; templates are kept
```

## Try it

Attach a poster or social post and ask: *Scan this design with Design DNA and save it as "Spring Launch".* Then: *Change only the headline to "Made for every day" and keep everything else.*
